column4: Associate DevOps Engineers are skilled engineers who assist in delivery & deployments of Cloud-based features for Agile Salesforce projects.
column5: DevOps engineers are tenured professionals with the skills necessary to produce improvements to the current procedure as well as build out deployment pipelines from the ground up following Salesforce best practices.
column6: A Senior DevOps Engineer is skilled in automating and streamlining deployments. They ensure smooth CI/CD pipelines using quality gates and manage development/configurations within version control. They are the direct liason between development and operations teams, manage the deployment lifecycles stability/scalability, and mentor/guide junior team members.
column7: Advises, designs, and manages the deployment orchestration solutions and technologies. They work closely with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, Solution Architects, and Account Teams. Additionally, they directly partner with clients to architect DevOps technology solutions to meet client needs. All solutions are in accordance with industry best practices to shape long-term/post-implementation customer success. The DevOps Architect is hands-on and performs architecture work. They may also perform deployments as needed.
column8: Responsible for designing and implementing robust DevOps practices and solutions that enhance efficiency, reliability and scalability for larger enterprise customers with complex, multi-cloud and multi-workstream implementations.  Provides leadership to a team of other DevOps engineers and/or Architects.  Supports strategic DevOps planning including Long term goals and aligning DevOps initiatives with overall business goals and objectives.
column9: Responsible for overseeing the DevOps practices and strategies within a large and complex organization.  Provides DevOps subject matter expertise across the organization.  Build and lead a team of DevOps architects, engineers, and specialists.  Provides pre-sales and scoping support outside of billable project activities.  Identifies, leads and oversees key DevOps initiatives from start to finish with minimal guidance and support.
column10: Advises, designs, and manages the transformation of large-scale programs. They work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Account Teams. Additionally, they directly partner with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs. All solutions are in accordance with industry best practices to shape long-term/post-implementation customer success. Leads internal efforts aligned to the organization's strategic roadmap.

Demonstrates a commitment to professional and personal development, driven by curiosity, self-motivation and a desire for growth.

Ability to recognize and understand emotions in oneself and others and use that understanding to make decisions, solve problems, and communicate with others; demonstrate empathy in interpersonal relationships.
Communicates (writes, presents, and speaks) and listens in a transparent way, driving trust and inspiration throughout the organization.
Encouraging others to implement better approaches to address problems and opportunities; leading the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.

Gather and analyze information and design comprehensive solutions that are flexible and adaptable to the client's needs. Includes determining relevant technical and business requirements specific to the customer.
Ability to provide relevant knowledge and demonstrate practical application in your particular area of expertise.

Creating and applying new insights based on an assessment of a customer's business, industry, and competitors to achieve success, leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance the depth and scope of this analysis and insight generation.

Ability to create, share or support a compelling picture, which combines experiences, customer examples and clear outcomes that reinforce the future state which moves people toward a common outcome or goal.
Displays a strong commitment to making performance improvements and a determination to achieve positive outcomes and results.

Understands and applies practices and processes that ensure technical decisions and implementations align with the organization's business strategy, goals, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.

Demonstrates ability to successfully complete the end-to-end process of taking a technical concept from proof of concept/technology to design and development of a fully functional and operational solution that delivers tangible value.
Working cooperatively with others to help a team, work group, or customer achieve its goals. Leverages others' strengths and contributions to realize the best outcome.
Drives the delivery of value-driven solutions through the application of iterative SDLC, Agile, and Salesforce Delivery Methodology principles.
